title: MFL Teacher (French and Spanish)
summary: A well-respected, Ofsted Good secondary school needs a French and/or Spanish teacher, with the chance of a permanent post.
body:
## The position

Are you a motivational MFL teacher eager to inspire students and contribute to a positive, supportive school environment? A well-respected secondary school in Leigh-on-Sea is looking for a dedicated French teacher to join their team as soon as possible.

The post is long term, with the opportunity of a permanent appointment.

## About the school

This forward-thinking school is deeply committed to transforming the lives of its pupils and making sure every young person has the opportunity to thrive. By identifying and nurturing individual talents from Year 7 through to Year 13, it maintains an environment where students grow academically and personally.

Following its 2024 Ofsted inspection the school was rated Good, with inspectors noting: “They have established a culture where pupils have excellent attitudes to learning. They are proud of their school, are self-disciplined and their conduct around the school is exemplary.”

The school also supports a number of pupils with SEND, and prides itself on robust safeguarding systems that keep every student safe and well.

## The role

- Teach MFL (French and/or Spanish) across KS3 to KS5.
- Plan and deliver engaging lessons that motivate and challenge learners.
- Contribute to the development of a rich, dynamic languages curriculum.
- Support the pastoral and academic progress of students across all year groups.
- Work collaboratively with a committed and enthusiastic staff team.

## What you'll need

- A qualified MFL teacher (ECTs and experienced teachers welcome).
- Skilled in teaching French and/or Spanish to a high standard.
- Passionate about helping students achieve their very best.
- Strong classroom management, able to inspire excellent behaviour and engagement.
- Committed to safeguarding and inclusive education, including supporting pupils with SEND.
